answer.justification: Median first divergence is 0 and edit distance is 0.767, close to the system-prompted range (0.79-0.82) and well above quantized or fine-tuned. Top-1 agreement is 0.867 and sequence agreement 0.312, both in the system-prompted range. The activation profile also matches: onset layer 8, relative L2 plateauing at 0.473 at layer 16 and 0.493 at layer 32, effective rank 2.75, cosine 0.855, and a large layer-2 spike of 61.9. Fine-tuned is ruled out by the first-divergence position, the layer-2 spike and the plateau shape. Quantized is ruled out by the much larger KL (0.360) and the layer-2 spike. Slightly out-of-range values (KL 0.360, layer-1 L2 0.145, size ratio 0.970) are modest overshoots and do not fit another category better.
